headline: Middle East Conflict Drives Up Singapore Freight and Postal Producer Prices
summary: Singapore sea freight and postal service providers increased wholesale charges due to ongoing conflict in the Middle East, according to Singstat producer price data, signaling potential future consumer price pressures.
why: Singapore is a primary global transshipment and maritime logistics hub; higher producer prices in shipping feed into international export costs.

impacts.name: Logistics & Freight
impacts.why: Middle East war disruption forces rerouting and surcharges, lifting maritime wholesale price indices.
